summary: Two stuck climbers on Kelso Ridge, one of them injured (2020-111)
notes: ART mission 2020-111. Torreys Peak; one injured. MERGED 2026-09-11 (run 102): MRA Meridian Winter 2020 'Rescued in the Rockies' first-person account by subject Mahir Dalwani (climbing with partner 'Baba') — dislocated shoulder on Kelso Ridge, Friday-night rescue; volunteers Curt and Dale reached them on the wall and belayed the raise (Dale 40+ yrs experience, Curt's first rescue); Wes, 66, retired investment banker, among the ~30-member response; after the pick-off the team finished the climb to Torreys summit then walked down the standard trail (~13 hrs trailhead-to-base); subjects went to ER, no hospital transport by the team.
